ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, there is a slope AB with the height of the top B from the ground BC being 30m. The gradient of slope AB, \(i = 1 \colon 2.5\), what is the horizontal distance AC of this slope?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since the slope $AB$ has a gradient $i = 1:2.5$, \\
hence $BC:AC = 1:2.5$, \\
since $BC = 30m$, \\
therefore $AC = 30 \times 2.5 = \boxed{75}m$
